newsitem.title: USA: Sealy Corp declares conditional cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: Sealy Corp declares conditional cash dividend.

text.p: Sealy Corp on Monday said it will declare a special cash dividend, but only if the company succeeds in arranging a new $275 million credit facility and winning approval for the dividend from holders of its 9.5 percent subordinated notes.
The dividend would be either $3.31 per share, or a per share amount equal to $100 million divided by the number of shares outstanding, whichever is lesser.

Sealy also said it was amending its consent solicitation of holders of those subordinated notes due in 2003. Sealy said it now would pay a total of $4 million on a pro rata basis to holders from whom a timely consent is received. If all holders consent, that would mean a minimum payment of $20 for each $1,000 in principal held.
Sealy also said it would increase the applicable interest rate on the notes to 10.25 percent, and it extended the solicitation expiration date to Feb 12.
